visualCharacteristics.purpose: horizontal row of office photo tiles; the open tile widens to show its description and a jobs link

contentPattern.structure: one row per location: photo | location name | description + link. The name may instead be the first paragraph of the details cell. The first tile starts open

reuseGuidance: Use for a handful (3 to 5) of locations or topics with a photo each, where one is expanded at a time. On mobile the tiles stack. For many items use cards-tool or accordion-manager.
